thread:
zoe_sales: Heads-up: NovaShop wants a 5-day POC. Scope: streaming SDK ingest of OCR'd receipt text -> function/tool calling to output strict JSON invoice (invoice_id, date, items[{sku, qty, unit_price}], subtotal, tax, total), SAML+SCIM for provisioning, EU data residency (eu-west), and a reserved-capacity estimate for ~200 qps peak. Can we start next Fri? :calendar:

 derek_se: Quick clarifying Qs: avg tokens post-OCR? burstiness vs steady qps? images or text?

 zoe_sales: They said ~120 tokens avg after OCR, text only (they'll OCR on-prem), bursts up to 220 qps for short windows. They want <150ms P95 for lookup flow.

 anya_devx: We can demo with the Python streaming SDK + function-calls. Minimal demo snippet for the walkthrough (streaming + function-calling showing incremental events):

 ```py
 # python pseudo-sample for demo
 from redwood import Client
 client = Client(api_key=POC_KEY)
 stream = client.responses.stream(
     model="redwood-small-1",
     input="Extract invoice JSON from this receipt text...",
     functions=[{
         "name": "normalize_invoice",
         "parameters": {
             "type": "object",
             "properties": {
                 "invoice_id": {"type": "string"},
                 "date": {"type": "string", "format": "date"},
                 "items": {"type": "array"},
                 "total": {"type": "number"}
             },
             "required": ["invoice_id", "items", "total"]
         }
     }],
     stream_mode=True
 )
 for event in stream:
     # event may be partial tokens or a function call payload
     print(event)
 ```

 anya_devx: Demo tips: enable prefix caching for repeated receipt headers, set max_batch_tokens and batch timeout low (e.g., 6ms) to hit latency SLO, and demo quantization tradeoffs (int8 cost vs float16 quality). Show schema-fail -> fallback text path so NovaShop sees robustness.

 kevin_security: Important: receipts often contain PAN fragments. Ask NovaShop to redact or tokenise card data before sending. PCI scope depends on whether cardholder data enters our environment. We'll provide SOC2 summary and complete their security questionnaire. If they need HSM-backed keys or dedicated KMS, that adds infra/legal gating. Internal sec link: https://redwood.internal/sec/presales-pci (internal).

 mike_infra: I can queue a temporary Dedicated POC cluster in eu-west. SCIM + SAML are supported on Dedicated; need their IdP metadata and SCIM base URL. Note: POC Dedicated allocation requires a short POC addendum signed by legal. If they require HSM isolation, escalate to infra.

 derek_se: Pricing for presales: offer a time-limited trial credit for the POC. For production reserved capacity sized for sustained 200 qps and the latency target, rough EU ballpark (subject to infra/finance): 


€11k-€18k/month depending on GPU class and redundancy. I'll follow-up with finance for a precise quote and a short one-pager.

 deploybot: infra-bot: dedicated-poc-eu-west queued for allocation (project: novashop-poc) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

 zoe_sales: Ask list for NovaShop: 1) SAML SP metadata + SCIM endpoint, 2) sample redacted OCR'd receipt text, 3) minute-level qps profile, 4) their security questionnaire (we'll send ours too). Proposing Fri 09:00 CET kickoff.

 mike_infra: Holding cluster queue until legal signs addendum. If they need dedicated HSM/KMS, flag and we'll escalate.

 anya_devx: I'll prepare a runbook: (1) streaming ingest -> (2) function call normalize_invoice -> (3) schema validation -> (4) small load test showing p95 latency and fallback behavior. Will attach simple locust/golang client script after.

 kevin_security: I'll draft the security questionnaire responses and add PCI scoping guidance. Expect my draft by Thu EOD.

 zoe_sales: Great. Next actions: I'll send NovaShop our questionnaire + metadata request now. Mike hold infra, Derek follow-up on pricing, Anya prep runbook + load script, Kevin finish sec draft Thu EOD. Thanks team! :rocket:
